headline: U.S. Treasury Yields Drop to One-Month Lows on Safe-Haven Demand
summary: Yields on U.S. Treasury securities fell to one-month lows as investors sought safe-haven assets amid heightened market risks.
why: U.S. Treasuries represent the global benchmark for risk-free assets. Movements in yields directly impact borrowing costs across global debt and equity markets.

impacts.name: U.S. Treasury Bonds
impacts.why: Investor demand for safe-haven assets increased bond prices and lowered yields.

why_moved: Treasury yields fell to one-month lows as investors shifted capital into government bonds seeking safety from escalating market risks.
